text:
Gold Price in 1990
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1990, the LBMA gold price fell 7.0% between 1990-01-31 ($415) and 1990-12-28 ($386). The highest sampled price was $415 in January and the lowest was $352 in June. The mean of these observations was $383. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
